test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All Machines are Tools.

No Tool is a Computer.

**Conclusions:**

I. No Machine is a Computer.

II. Some Computers are Tools.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statements:

All Machines are Tools.

No Tool is a Computer.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d6e3f484c0b43d83038ac46e0e21cdb47ddd95779d6b228d8c12df298a33bde.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No Machine is a Computer → Ture (because all machines are tools and no tool is a computer so definitely no machine is a computer)

II. Some Computers are Tools → False (because statement given no Tool is a Computer so some computers are tools it is not possible)

Hence, “**Only conclusion I follow**” is the correct answer.
